openapi: 3.1.0
info:
  title: SCOPe REST API
  version: v1
  description: >
    Read-only JSON API for low-cost SCOP/ASTRAL/SCOPe lookups, release-scoped
    hierarchy traversal, indexed search, static-download manifests, and
    paginated collections. Biological data endpoints are release-scoped for
    data selection. Base releases such as 2.08 can receive periodic updates;
    dated selectors do not promise immutable archived snapshots.
    The site's /.well-known/api-catalog provides machine-readable discovery;
    HTTP Link headers advertise the api-catalog and service-desc relations.
servers:
  - url: https://scop.berkeley.edu/api/v1
tags:
  - {name: metadata}
  - {name: search}
  - {name: releases}
  - {name: nodes}
  - {name: pdb}
  - {name: sequences}
  - {name: astral}
  - {name: downloads}
paths:
  /:
    get:
      tags: [metadata]
      operationId: getServiceIndex
      summary: Service metadata and canonical endpoint hints
      responses:
        '200':
          description: OK
          content:
            application/json:
              schema: {$ref: '#/components/schemas/ServiceIndex'}
  /openapi.yaml:
    get:
      tags: [metadata]
      operationId: getOpenApiYaml
      summary: OpenAPI document
      responses:
        '200': {description: OK}
  /levels:
    get:
      tags: [metadata]
      operationId: listLevels
      summary: SCOP hierarchy levels
      responses:
        '200':
          description: OK
          content:
            application/json:
              schema: {$ref: '#/components/schemas/LevelsResponse'}
  /releases:
    get:
      tags: [releases]
      operationId: listReleases
      summary: List public SCOP/SCOPe releases
      responses:
        '200':
          description: OK
          content:
            application/json:
              schema: {$ref: '#/components/schemas/ReleasesResponse'}
  /releases/current:
    get:
      tags: [releases]
      operationId: getCurrentRelease
      summary: Current public release, including latest periodic update label where applicable
      responses:
        '200':
          description: OK
          content:
            application/json:
              schema: {$ref: '#/components/schemas/Release'}
  /releases/{release}:
    get:
      tags: [releases]
      operationId: getRelease
      summary: Public release metadata and current periodic update label
      parameters:
        - {$ref: '#/components/parameters/releasePath'}
      responses:
        '200':
          description: OK
          content:
            application/json:
              schema: {$ref: '#/components/schemas/Release'}
  /search:
    get:
      tags: [search]
      operationId: searchCurrentRelease
      summary: Indexed discovery search in the current release
      description: >
        Uses materialized API search tables. This endpoint does not run broad
        MySQL full-text or leading-wildcard searches. Use it for discovery,
        then fetch exact release-scoped node/PDB endpoints for interpretation.
      parameters:
        - {$ref: '#/components/parameters/searchQuery'}
        - {$ref: '#/components/parameters/searchMode'}
        - {$ref: '#/components/parameters/limit'}
        - {$ref: '#/components/parameters/cursor'}
      responses:
        '200': {$ref: '#/components/responses/SearchOk'}
        '400': {$ref: '#/components/responses/Problem'}
        '422': {$ref: '#/components/responses/Problem'}
        '503': {$ref: '#/components/responses/Problem'}
  /downloads:
    get:
      tags: [downloads]
      operationId: listCurrentDownloads
      summary: Static download manifest for the current release
      responses:
        '200': {$ref: '#/components/responses/DownloadsOk'}
  /releases/{release}/root:
    get:
      tags: [nodes]
      operationId: getReleaseRoot
      summary: Root node for a release
      parameters:
        - {$ref: '#/components/parameters/releasePath'}
      responses:
        '200': {$ref: '#/components/responses/NodeOk'}
        '404': {$ref: '#/components/responses/Problem'}
  /releases/{release}/search:
    get:
      tags: [search]
      operationId: searchRelease
      summary: Indexed discovery search in a specific release
      parameters:
        - {$ref: '#/components/parameters/releasePath'}
        - {$ref: '#/components/parameters/searchQuery'}
        - {$ref: '#/components/parameters/searchMode'}
        - {$ref: '#/components/parameters/limit'}
        - {$ref: '#/components/parameters/cursor'}
      responses:
        '200': {$ref: '#/components/responses/SearchOk'}
        '400': {$ref: '#/components/responses/Problem'}
        '422': {$ref: '#/components/responses/Problem'}
        '503': {$ref: '#/components/responses/Problem'}
  /releases/{release}/resolve/{identifier}:
    get:
      tags: [nodes]
      operationId: resolveIdentifier
      summary: Resolve a public SCOPe identifier in a release
      parameters:
        - {$ref: '#/components/parameters/releasePath'}
        - name: identifier
          in: path
          required: true
          schema: {type: string}
      responses:
        '200':
          description: OK
          content:
            application/json:
              schema: {$ref: '#/components/schemas/ResolveResponse'}
        '404': {$ref: '#/components/responses/Problem'}
  /releases/{release}/sunids/{sunid}:
    get:
      tags: [nodes]
      operationId: getNodeBySunid
      summary: Node by public SUNID
      parameters:
        - {$ref: '#/components/parameters/releasePath'}
        - {$ref: '#/components/parameters/sunid'}
      responses:
        '200': {$ref: '#/components/responses/NodeOk'}
        '404': {$ref: '#/components/responses/Problem'}
  /releases/{release}/sunids/{sunid}/parents:
    get:
      tags: [nodes]
      operationId: getSunidParents
      summary: Node parent lineage
      parameters:
        - {$ref: '#/components/parameters/releasePath'}
        - {$ref: '#/components/parameters/sunid'}
      responses:
        '200': {$ref: '#/components/responses/LineageOk'}
  /releases/{release}/sunids/{sunid}/children:
    get:
      tags: [nodes]
      operationId: getSunidChildren
      summary: Seek-paginated child nodes
      parameters:
        - {$ref: '#/components/parameters/releasePath'}
        - {$ref: '#/components/parameters/sunid'}
        - {$ref: '#/components/parameters/limit'}
        - {$ref: '#/components/parameters/cursor'}
      responses:
        '200': {$ref: '#/components/responses/ChildrenOk'}
  /releases/{release}/sunids/{sunid}/annotations:
    get:
      tags: [nodes]
      operationId: getSunidAnnotations
      summary: Comments, inconsistencies, repeats, and xrefs
      parameters:
        - {$ref: '#/components/parameters/releasePath'}
        - {$ref: '#/components/parameters/sunid'}
      responses:
        '200': {$ref: '#/components/responses/AnnotationsOk'}
  /releases/{release}/sunids/{sunid}/images:
    get:
      tags: [nodes]
      operationId: getSunidImages
      summary: Thumbnail and larger static images for a node
      parameters:
        - {$ref: '#/components/parameters/releasePath'}
        - {$ref: '#/components/parameters/sunid'}
      responses:
        '200': {$ref: '#/components/responses/ImagesOk'}
  /releases/{release}/sunids/{sunid}/homology:
    get:
      tags: [nodes]
      operationId: getSunidHomology
      summary: Homology scope and warnings for a node
      parameters:
        - {$ref: '#/components/parameters/releasePath'}
        - {$ref: '#/components/parameters/sunid'}
      responses:
        '200': {$ref: '#/components/responses/HomologyOk'}
  /releases/{release}/sunids/{sunid}/fatcat-chain-statistics:
    get:
      tags: [nodes]
      operationId: getSunidFatcatChainStatistics
      summary: Node-specific FATCAT chain-statistics classification consistency
      description: >
        Returns the classification match fraction and observation count for a
        family, superfamily, or fold SUNID. These are stored historical
        classification-consistency aggregates, not evidence of homology or the
        probability that a current hit is correct. Provenance fields are omitted
        pending a better provenance implementation. No provenance metadata table
        is required. The release parameter selects the classification context.
      parameters:
        - {$ref: '#/components/parameters/releasePath'}
        - {$ref: '#/components/parameters/sunid'}
        - {$ref: '#/components/parameters/statisticsMinimumSupportingHits'}
      responses:
        '200': {$ref: '#/components/responses/FatcatChainStatisticsOk'}
        '400': {$ref: '#/components/responses/Problem'}
        '404': {$ref: '#/components/responses/Problem'}
        '503': {$ref: '#/components/responses/Problem'}
  /releases/{release}/sids/{sid}:
    get:
      tags: [nodes]
      operationId: getNodeBySid
      summary: Node by public SCOPe domain identifier
      parameters:
        - {$ref: '#/components/parameters/releasePath'}
        - {$ref: '#/components/parameters/sid'}
      responses:
        '200': {$ref: '#/components/responses/NodeOk'}
        '404': {$ref: '#/components/responses/Problem'}
  /releases/{release}/sids/{sid}/parents:
    get:
      tags: [nodes]
      operationId: getSidParents
      summary: Node parent lineage for a SID
      parameters:
        - {$ref: '#/components/parameters/releasePath'}

item.text: {"answers":[{"question_id":"Q017_prp8_evolutionary_mosaic","answer":"The release-scoped entry confirms that Prp8 is chain A and is split into five domains; I’m checking the hierarchy labels and annotations so the evolutionary claims stay at the correct family/superfamily/fold strength.","evidence_used":[]}]}

{"answers":[{"question_id":"Q017_prp8_evolutionary_mosaic","answer":"In current SCOPe release 2.08, Prp8 is chain A of 3jb9 and is decomposed into five consecutive domains, revealing an evolutionary mosaic rather than a single-domain lineage: (1) d3jb9a5, residues 47–697, d.394.1.1, is the Prp8/Spp42 N-terminal domain and defines the newly observed fold d.394; (2) d3jb9a4, 698–822, a.29.2.1, belongs to the bromodomain family; (3) d3jb9a3, 823–1604, e.8.1.8, is a Prp8 reverse-transcriptase domain in the DNA/RNA-polymerase superfamily, with SCOPe annotations specifically noting homology to retroviral RT domains and inclusion of a linker region; (4) d3jb9a2, 1605–1780, c.52.1.36, is an endonuclease-like domain in the restriction-endonuclease-like superfamily, for which SCOPe records likely homology to characterized endonucleases; and (5) d3jb9a1, 1784–2030, c.55.3.14, is the Prp8 beta-finger domain, a distinct family within the RNase H-like superfamily. Thus four modules reuse previously characterized structural/evolutionary themes—bromodomain, polymerase/RT, restriction-endonuclease-like, and RNase H-like—whereas the large N-terminal module introduced a new SCOPe fold. The clustered RT-, nuclease-, and RNase-H-like modules are consistent with recruitment or fusion of an ancient retroelement/group-II-intron-like core during spliceosome evolution, but the classification alone does not prove that exact ancestry.
